entrada.titulo: On the adoption and deployment of secure and privacy-preserving IIoT in smart manufacturing: a comprehensive guide with recent advances

perfil_anterior.problema: Inadequate authentication mechanism : Weak authentication and authorization mechanisms also exist within those communication channels.
perfil_anterior.solucao: provide an overview of the comprehensive guidelines, which include measures and protocols to be followed during the adoption and deployment of IIoT tools and infrastructure
perfil_anterior.limites: system is not readily available as a commercial product
perfil_anterior.possibilidades: Explorar a integração de blockchain para registro imutável de eventos de autenticação falha em NB‑IoT e Wireless‑HART.; Aplicar Self‑Sovereign Identity (SSI) com Verifiable Credentials para reforçar a autenticação de dispositivos OT/IT.; Investigar o uso de Attribute‑Based Encryption (ABE) na proteção de dados transmitidos por Modbus e MQTT.; Desenvolver um framework de colaboração IT‑OT que inclua métricas de segurança e processos de troca de informações em tempo real.

dows XP , while many IIoT systems depend on obsolete
ﬁrmware or vulnerable third-party components [ 52].
Nonetheless, ensuring security for both the SCADA
systems and PLCs is of utmost importance due to the
many vulnerabilities they present in both the ﬁrmware
and software components of the IIoT systems, which
include a range of cyber threats such as ransomware,
spooﬁng, DoS/DDoS, worm-based malware, etc. Major
weaknesses of such systems include the following:
a. Inadequate understanding of the devices associated
with SCADA and PLCs systems from both the OT
and IT sides.
b. Lack of secure authentication mechanisms for access
control and data protection.
c. Lack of security measures related to remote access.
d. Software design without adequate security consider-
ation.
e. Enabling unlimited uploads on such systems and
deploying PLCs operating system with vulnerabil-
ities.
Likewise, considering that the majority of smart manufac-
turing facilities include several devices intended for remote
access, other attack vectors exploit vulnerabilities such as:
1. Intercepting unencrypted passwords on ICS networks.
2. Utilizing preconﬁgured passwords or SSH keys for
ﬁrmware authentication.
3. Exploiting the code execution process of a device in order
to get unauthorized access to conﬁdential data.

resposta.resumo: O trecho destaca vulnerabilidades críticas em sistemas IIoT de manufatura inteligente, como uso de sistemas operacionais obsoletos, firmware vulnerável e falta de mecanismos seguros de autenticação e controle de acesso, além de riscos de acesso remoto não protegido e design de software sem segurança.
